# CLI: VKS

Reads Kubernetes cluster inventory, versions, and quota, and creates and deletes private clusters.
Works in `hcm-3` and `han-1`; create and delete are verified live only in `hcm-3`.
`--project-id` does not select a VKS workspace. Reads work under `--read-only`.
Output contains account data.
See [VKS](VKS.md) for the SDK models and scope.

Every list prints `{"Items": [...]}`, so a `--query` starts with `Items`.

## create-cluster

Kind: Write.

Requires --yes. There is no quote API. Worker servers and disks, the private cluster's managed load balancer, and four service endpoints incur charges. The order is prepaid for one month from credits; a one-node private cluster debited about 2,137,000 VND at create in one recorded run, and deleting it refunded the unused value. That figure is an example, not an estimate; cost depends on the node group, flavor, and disks. Auto-renew is off. ACTIVE means provisioned, not workload ready. Cluster names must have 5 to 20 characters; node group names must have 5 to 15. Names use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit. The disk type, flavor, and subnet must be in the same zone. Use network get-subnet for ZoneID and volume get-default-volume-type --zone-id <that zone> for the disk type.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--name` | `string` | yes |
| `--version` | `string` | yes |
| `--vpc-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--subnet-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--pod-cidr` | `string` | yes |
| `--node-group-name` | `string` | yes |
| `--num-nodes` | `int` | yes |
| `--flavor-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--os` | `string` | yes |
| `--disk-size` | `int` | yes |
| `--disk-type-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--security-group-id` | `[]string` | yes |
| `--ssh-key-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--no-wait` | `bool` |  |

```sh
vngcloud vks create-cluster --name <name> --version <version> --vpc-id <vpc-id> --subnet-id <subnet-id> --pod-cidr <pod-cidr> --node-group-name <node-group-name> --num-nodes <num-nodes> --flavor-id <flavor-id> --os <os> --disk-size <disk-size> --disk-type-id <disk-type-id> --security-group-id <security-group-id> --ssh-key-id <ssh-key-id>
```

## delete-cluster

Kind: Write, destructive.

Deletes the cluster named by exact ID, public or private. A 404 after a successful preflight read confirms deletion. Deletion does not promise a refund.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--cluster-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--no-wait` | `bool` |  |

```sh
vngcloud vks delete-cluster --cluster-id <cluster-id> --yes
```

## get-quota

Kind: Read.

No fields.

```sh
vngcloud vks get-quota --query Quota
```

## list-cluster-versions

Kind: Read.

No fields.

```sh
vngcloud vks list-cluster-versions
```

## list-clusters

Kind: Read.

Pages start at 0, with a default size of 10. Each call reads one page.
Request the next page with `--page 1`. Use `--size` to set the page size.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--page` | `int` |  |
| `--size` | `int` |  |

```sh
vngcloud vks list-clusters \
  --query 'Items[].{ID:ID,Name:Name,Status:Status,Version:Version}' \
  --output table
```
